ruling1: satake.ts: after the admissibility check and the oracle's asserts, and just before classifyRestricted, satake builds the restricted board. If the pair has white orbits and that board is in more than one piece, satake throws NeedsConnectedBoard (an EngineError) with the message 'satake needs a restricted root system in one piece; the restricted board of this pair is in K pieces'. restrictedBoard is unchanged: on such a pair it returns labels 1..m in orbit order and no name. One test pins both on the split form of A2+A2: the class, the message, orbits [[0],[1],[2],[3]], the A2+A2 Cartan matrix, labels [1,2,3,4], no name, two components. A second test on the same board checks that complex sl(3,C) (tau exchanging the pieces) is still computed: A2, multiplicity 2, restricted board A2. On the review's 267 admissible pairs the new throw happens exactly on the 26 pairs where the oracle raises, and the 167 records are unchanged.
